name: CHROMEWORKS Phantom Veil Stealth Ocular Mk2
description:
The Phantom Veil Mk2 is a full-replacement stealth-optimized ocular system combining passive continuous recording at 4K resolution with an active facial recognition scrambling field — a micro-EM emitter ring around the iris that subtly distorts the wearer's own facial geometry in camera systems and AR recognition networks without being visible to the naked eye. Low-light amplification reaches 0.0005 lux functional vision through a multi-layer photon-multiplying substrate, and the lens surface defaults to a flat, non-reflective matte appearance that reads as natural brown or grey to casual observers. The scrambling field operates on a rotating distortion algorithm updated via encrypted Chromeworks uplink every 48 hours.

The Phantom Veil Mk2 occupies an uncomfortable legal gray zone — the recording and low-light functions are Licensed, but the facial recognition scrambler tips it into Restricted territory in most GLMZ jurisdictions, which hasn't slowed sales to journalists, corporate intelligence operatives, privacy advocates, or anyone whose livelihood depends on not being catalogued. Chromeworks markets them through a subsidiary to maintain deniability, and the street knows exactly what that means.
installation_requirements: Standard ocular extraction; scrambler emitter ring requires precise orbital calibration; Chromeworks subsidiary installer or trusted independent
rejection_risk: Low — standard Chromeworks biocompatible housing; emitter ring adds minor tissue irritation risk at orbital margin
maintenance: 48-hour scrambler algorithm auto-update via encrypted uplink; annual emitter ring inspection; lens cleaning monthly

side_effects: Scrambler field causes mild persistent headaches in approximately 20% of users during first month of adaptation
Continuous recording creates compulsive review behavior in some users — an inability to stop watching their own archived footage
Low-light amplification at extreme sensitivity causes painful flash-response in sudden bright environments
Scrambler field occasionally interferes with friendly facial recognition systems, locking users out of their own secure spaces
cultural_context: In a city where every corner runs a recognition sweep and corporate AR networks log faces like inventory, the Phantom Veil Mk2 has become a quiet symbol of deliberate anonymity — worn by people who know exactly how surveillance works and have decided to opt out. The authorities officially disapprove; they also quietly use a military-stripped variant themselves.
known_users: Runners and fixers operating in Tier 2-4 spaces
Persons of interest who need to stay unlogged
story_hooks: A player's Phantom Veil Mk2 scrambler begins logging the faces it's hiding the wearer from — someone has pushed a malicious update through the encrypted uplink
A journalist's recorded footage from their Phantom Veil surfaces on the black market, but the journalist is dead and the footage shows something that powerful people will kill to suppress
The 48-hour algorithm update fails city-wide for all Phantom Veil Mk2 units simultaneously — every wearer is suddenly visible, and someone timed it deliberately
